approval_scope: Only these exact three file hashes, keys and MIME types in this bucket; no overwrites, other objects, database writes, public exposure, configuration changes, deployment, push or E/F.
before_each_future_put: Require written approval for this proposal and exact bucket.
Recheck source hashes and unique account against known Hampton resources.
Recheck bucket privacy and absence of each exact key immediately before its put; stop on any uncertainty or collision.
Use an empty temporary working directory and explicit remote bucket/key; do not inherit business wrangler configuration.

put_metadata.storage_class: inherit bucket default; no configuration changes

after_each_future_put: GET that exact remote object into a temporary local file.
Compare full SHA-256 and byte count with this proposal; record result without credentials.
uncertain_result_policy: Stop and GET the exact remote key before any retry. If matching bytes already exist, record verified without another PUT; if different or unreadable, stop. No blind replay or deletion.
wrangler_put_overwrite_limitation: Wrangler PUT is not an atomic create-only guard; the exact-key absence check is a precondition, not protection against a concurrent writer. Stop if concurrent writes are suspected.
